narrative.overview: A quiet, high-density technical workspace where operational state and data outrank decoration.

rules.name: Sparse Accent
rules.body: Cobalt identifies current context or primary action and never decorates containers.

rules.name: Flat by Default
rules.body: Depth comes from tonal planes and dividers rather than shadows.

dos: Keep operational status near its workspace
donts: Hide destructive actions behind unlabeled icons
